stage0013_03:r_1c0f94acd5a8a143.text: ～ $$ルイス・ハレヴィ$$'s Hospital Room ～

stage0013_03:r_1263541f4071624e.text:
$$ルイス$$
「... I see.
　So you're headed to Industrial 7.」

stage0013_03:r_3bc300bbdc277d82.text:
$$沙慈$$
「Yeah...
　My off-world training at Anaheim Tech starts soon.」

stage0013_03:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
$$ルイス$$
「Be careful.
　Space is... dangerous right now, they say.」

stage0013_03:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$$タクヤ$$
「Don't worry, Miss $$ルイス$$.
　We'll take real good care of $$沙慈$$.」

stage0013_03:r_1d6bc48b7f246730.text:
$$ミコット$$
「Industrial 7 is
　the colony we used to live on, after all.」

stage0013_03:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$$ルイス$$
「Thank you, $$タクヤ$$, $$ミコット$$.」

stage0013_03:r_9e701cdeb3842c21.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Ah... thank you very much.」

stage0013_03:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$タクヤ$$
「Well then, $$沙慈$$... we'll head on ahead.」

stage0013_03:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$$ミコット$$
「Well then, Miss $$ルイス$$...
　let's meet up again when you're back on Earth.」

stage0013_03:r_5cd353758cfe474d.text:
$$沙慈$$
「Looks like $$バナージ$$'s your favorite of them, $$ルイス$$.」

stage0013_03:r_a653c8dec4c0f06f.text:
$$ルイス$$
「I wonder...
　Maybe it's how he's always looking off
　somewhere distant, a little like that person...」

stage0013_03:r_09d0fcc600cdd3df.text:
$$ルイス$$
「Heh... so $$沙慈$$ was thinking the same thing.」

stage0013_03:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
$$沙慈$$
「I wonder what he's doing right now...」

stage0013_03:r_6fd86c96891ea942.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Good work, $n.
　That's the simulator done for today.」

stage0013_03:r_d80a9688790ed583.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Target kill rate, 97.2 percent.
　Might be about time to move up a grade.」

stage0013_03:r_7b6f159eeaf4de0f.text:
$$カツ$$
「You could at least look a little happy.
　Reaching Grade 2 after six weeks of fighting
　is really something, you know.」

stage0013_03:r_ff6f8bdca2dd2bc9.text:
$$カツ$$
「Not enough...?
　Are you trying to pass up $$カミーユ$$ and Lt. $$エマ$$
　and become this unit's ace or something?」

stage0013_03:r_567b361a454c4b73.text:
$$リディ$$
「That's enough, $$カツ$$.
　Wanting to push past your limits
　is just... a pilot's nature. No, human nature.」

stage0013_03:r_352534f64413d954.text:
$$リディ$$
「All right, $n.
　If you think you still need more training,
　you're sparring with me.」

stage0013_03:r_1c5aa0d15ae24846.text:
$$ファ$$
「$$カミーユ$$, are you worried too
　about $n overtraining?」

stage0013_03:r_7a7add80fde475ba.text:
$$カミーユ$$
（$n's eyes, the ones I glimpse sometimes...
　If that's the reason they fight...）

stage0013_03:r_2103f6df2ea2e447.text:
$$エマ$$
「So Miss $$スズネ$$'s worried about $n too...?」

stage0013_03:r_a12e3e130d896ff7.text:
$$スズネ$$
「That's part of it,
　but also how things stand between Earth and space...」

stage0013_03:r_b6f7b219eb4bd64b.text:
$$エマ$$
「I read the report that came in from $$プリベンター$$,
　and it really is a strange incident.」

stage0013_03:r_91bf33c27ad39f0a.text:
$$カツ$$
「Maybe they were all mass-hypnotized or something?」

stage0013_03:r_ee220318b96ab538.text:
$$エマ$$
「Just who would use hypnosis like that,
　and for what purpose?」

stage0013_03:r_c304df6888eb78f7.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Besides, I can't believe there's hypnosis
　that could sway that many people at once.」

stage0013_03:r_c26958634526e597.text:
$$カツ$$
「I was just saying whatever came to mind...」

stage0013_03:r_cdb750c9d380881a.text:
$$ファ$$
「$$カミーユ$$... don't tell me...」

stage0013_03:r_95fda74613c97b39.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「I considered that possibility too.」

stage0013_03:r_1956994937f8171e.text:
$$カミーユ$$
（Certainly, 《$$ギアス$$》 could make it possible.
　But I can't believe the $$ゼロ$$ we know now would do
　something like that. And more than that...）

stage0013_03:r_48f49f6728c15612.text:
$$スズネ$$
「More than that, what would be the point
　of stirring up conflict between Earth and the
　colonies that way, I wonder...」

stage0013_03:r_0ebc5a6f1e0f81bf.text:
$$カツ$$
「I think the Earth supremacists in the Federation
　and Neo Zeon's pro-war faction
　both want a war either way...」

stage0013_03:r_f02c37d91387d0ad.text:
$$エマ$$
「But people like that
　could push us toward war more directly,
　like with that provocation the other day.」

stage0013_03:r_6bbd5a3c5afb87e0.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Whatever the process, what matters most right now
　is that Earth and colonies are heading toward war...」

stage0013_03:r_9796b3efa401a303.text:
$$ファ$$
「I won't say the Earth Federation has no faults,
　but that doesn't mean it should come to war...」

stage0013_03:r_643b6eebfc0186b3.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Lt. $$エマ$$, how are the other colony groups
　reading this situation?」

stage0013_03:r_291280e5f7eb9d70.text:
$$エマ$$
「Some of the $$ＡＤＷ$$'s colony nations
　lean toward Neo Zeon, given their history.」

stage0013_03:r_32eb462c1b4999cb.text:
$$エマ$$
「《$$プラント$$》 keeps a neutral stance too,
　but there are rumors they're in touch with Neo Zeon.」

stage0013_03:r_1f4337d6d393fc37.text:
$$ファ$$
「$$プラント$$ fought on Earth's side during the $$ＵＣＷ$$ too...
　I wonder if that's still affecting things now...」

stage0013_03:r_4740e748fae085ee.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「The $$ＵＣＷ$$'s $$多元戦争$$, and the $$ＡＤＷ$$'s
　$$再世戦争$$, might not be over yet...」

stage0013_03:r_859dfa27bcaafe30.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「Captain $$オットー$$,
　I've brought Mr. $$アルベルト・ビスト$$
　of Anaheim Electronics.」

stage0013_03:r_71ebf05996a4b0fd.text:
Otto
「Welcome aboard the $$ネェル・アーガマ$$.
　I'm her captain, Colonel $$オットー・ミタス$$.」

stage0013_03:r_6214c11b1bca811e.text:
Alberto
「$$アルベルト・ビスト$$.
　I'm in your care as far as Industrial 7.」

stage0013_03:r_8eaf6f3098ffed12.text:
$$アルベルト$$
「Right away, Captain... the schedule to our
　destination, could it be moved up further?」

stage0013_03:r_cf507214fe955d75.text:
$$オットー$$
「Is there a need to do that?」

stage0013_03:r_2113dcbabdfc758a.text:
$$アルベルト$$
「You needn't pry into my reasons.
　I'm asking whether it's possible or not.」

stage0013_03:r_4b0e43ba6a5f2f5b.text:
$$オットー$$
「... Mr. $$アルベルト$$,
　I am this ship's captain.
　The right to decide her operations is mine.」

stage0013_03:r_6a74519e1fc29c4b.text:
$$オットー$$
「Whoever you may be,
　I intend to do everything in my power
　to keep this ship safe and see our mission through.」

stage0013_03:r_5b992878fee054b5.text:
$$アルベルト$$
「And isn't that mission to deliver me
　to Industrial 7 promptly?」

stage0013_03:r_95a3dd16c2c4cc3e.text:
$$オットー$$
「Of course, I understand that.
　But I want to know if there's real necessity
　to force the schedule ahead of plan.」

stage0013_03:r_4a14ec0c511c7f0d.text:
$$アルベルト$$
「This is getting us nowhere...
　I told you, I'm in a hurry.」

stage0013_03:r_20cf167c0ec0d4d5.text:
$$ミヒロ$$
「Captain...!
　An urgent transmission from a $$プリベンター$$ agent!」

stage0013_03:r_b591d812c96c6c99.text:
$$ミヒロ$$
「They say a large-scale riot may break out
　on the Side 4 colony Ariel!」

stage0013_03:r_fb05d8e5f1ee93e5.text:
$$オットー$$
「This is bad!
　Vice Minister Darlian and Princess $$マリナ$$
　are giving a speech there right now!」

stage0013_03:r_c33bd700553abf91.text:
$$オットー$$
「Damn it!
　So we're already running into that incident!?」

stage0013_03:r_3599f0a4343fd95c.text:
Citizen
「The Earth Federation doesn't see colonists as human!」

stage0013_03:r_3bc7834a5bf3ee76.text:
Citizen
「We must overthrow the Earth Federation,
　or Spacenoids will never be truly free!」

stage0013_03:r_366814efdc8b5800.text:
$$マリナ$$
「Vice Minister Darlian, what is this...!?」

stage0013_03:r_9be1a4c10bb62515.text:
$$リリーナ$$
「I don't know...!
　Until just now, everyone was calmly
　discussing coexistence between Earth and space...!」

stage0013_03:r_94a88c90e557e16e.text:
$$シーリン$$
「Princess $$マリナ$$, Vice Minister...!
　It's too dangerous to stay here!
　We need to evacuate, now!」

stage0013_03:r_1c208ca0cbf26f28.text:
$$リリーナ$$
「But, $$シーリン$$...!
　We can't just leave this be...!」

stage0013_03:r_5b7ee307a700171a.text:
$$クラウス$$
「I understand how you feel!
　But the crowd's already turned into a mob!」

stage0013_03:r_4e5c8e989c4a7691.text:
Citizen
「They must've come to this colony
　just to win us over!」

stage0013_03:r_1fe8564d2b959317.text:
$$デュオ$$
「That was just a warning shot.
　Push it further, and I won't miss.」

stage0013_03:r_f527e012803f7f1c.text:
$$リリーナ$$
「You're... $$デュオ・マックスウェル$$!」

stage0013_03:r_4b1247bd3ca4905d.text:
$$デュオ$$
「Good, that's a relief.
　If you'd called me '$$ヒイロ$$'s partner,'
　even I'd be shocked.」

stage0013_03:r_338f3b27e51dcc41.text:
$$デュオ$$
「Well, simply put, I'm secret security.
　...Representative, hurry and get
　the princesses out of here!」

stage0013_03:r_d91d4bc2d52b61c4.text:
$$クラウス$$
「Sorry!
　I'll leave this to you!」

stage0013_03:r_4dbfba00ba7744ee.text:
$$デュオ$$
（Well... I've done the bare minimum for now,
　but the problem's whoever's exploiting this riot.）

stage0013_03:r_be100a32b731708d.text:
$$デュオ$$
（Well... guess I'll leave that part to him.）

stage0013_03:r_3dad695c99e9e052.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「...Can't say I believe that so easily...」

stage0013_03:r_66d4ae3a21caf881.text:
$$デュオ$$
「Same goes for me, and I was there.」

stage0013_03:r_0c18da7b3a37825d.text:
$$デュオ$$
「The one who started trashing the Federation
　was preaching Earth-colony coexistence yesterday.」

stage0013_03:r_63249745ffae61b6.text:
$$デュオ$$
「Someone like that led the charge,
　so the anti-Federation crowd there
　snapped all at once into a riot.」

stage0013_03:r_abdb034ae8509702.text:
$$カツ$$
「Those people...
　weren't they anti-Federation types
　wearing a pacifist mask?」

stage0013_03:r_3ff2e21207d1d1d3.text:
$$デュオ$$
「Well, everyone's got a face and a front.
　Unless you're a hopeless romantic,
　every colonist resents the Federation some.」

stage0013_03:r_e51ecf6d6aa42e75.text:
$$デュオ$$
「But the ones who caused the riot
　had buried all that to preach coexistence...」

stage0013_03:r_47ddabb7b60131c2.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Could it be that stress crushed them,
　and their true feelings just ran wild?」

stage0013_03:r_b025267f22788233.text:
$$デュオ$$
「One or two cases, sure, that could happen.
　But similar incidents popping up all over
　is way too unnatural.」

stage0013_03:r_ec1a06a7023bf72c.text:
$$リディ$$
「So you and $$ヒイロ$$ over there think
　someone's hand is behind
　these incidents?」

stage0013_03:r_8805f96e52aaa462.text:
$$デュオ$$
「I don't really want to think so...」

stage0013_03:r_4bf9b05b5f948170.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「I understand what you want to say.
　But I believe in $$ゼロ$$.」

stage0013_03:r_eaa52d152f444bfd.text:
$$リディ$$
「$$ゼロ$$...?
　You mean the $$ゼロ$$ from the Black Knights?」

stage0013_03:r_b4bc9e9435b58e6f.text:
$n
「So it's the Black Knights' supreme commander...
　the resistance that brought down $$皇帝ルルーシュ$$...」

stage0013_03:r_a9227573166977a9.text:
$n
「Why would that $$ゼロ$$ be tied to this incident?」

stage0013_03:r_7cbc63dad295f862.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Good timing, I'll explain to $n and the rest.
　$$ゼロ$$ had a power to control people... 《$$ギアス$$》.」

stage0013_03:r_2d09c6f6a2d990ea.text:
$$スズネ$$
「A power to control people...
　If such a power exists, it could explain
　the frequent clashes between Earth and colonies...」

stage0013_03:r_0476ffd10c764b0e.text:
$$リディ$$
「You say that, but nothing else explains it...!」

stage0013_03:r_48c6c1ecfea6fe4a.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Let's stop, Ensign.
　No point arguing over something we can't confirm.」

stage0013_03:r_2b3479c4cf0680f4.text:
$$リディ$$
「You're right...
　Sorry about that, $$ヒイロ$$.」

stage0013_03:r_9d7b02c5e728b7aa.text:
$$カツ$$
「What I don't get
　is the actions of that other Gundam pilot
　from the colonies too.」

stage0013_03:r_d7f1c506e78e55ff.text:
$$デュオ$$
「That's $$トロワ・バートン$$...
　Just as quiet as he looks and sounds.」

stage0013_03:r_0c705091f748360e.text:
$$カツ$$
「Did he become a terrorist too,
　out of resentment for the Federation?」

stage0013_03:r_9eb8599304125b2f.text:
$$デュオ$$
「Who knows.
　But he wasn't serious today.」

stage0013_03:r_a072aa25e5f521e0.text:
$$デュオ$$
「My guess: he was ordered to stall us,
　but had no real intention of following through.」

stage0013_03:r_03b5db9ce98fb8d6.text:
$$デュオ$$
「That makes me curious where this ship's headed.」

stage0013_03:r_3915fb4102f1c1dd.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Some group wants to stop us getting there...
　and something's about to happen there soon...」

stage0013_03:r_817b2773b4ed563e.text:
$$デュオ$$
「Hey, where's this ship even headed?」

stage0013_03:r_e180b22d18f48d38.text:
$$リディ$$
「And we've got an Anaheim executive
　aboard the $$ネェル・アーガマ$$.」

stage0013_03:r_e598c2a0b27e7f50.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Anaheim and terrorists...
　what's waiting for us at Industrial 7...」

stage0013_03:r_8fe40600ce62dfbc.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You're our new companions, I take it?」

stage0013_03:r_ff4ce5f3cf96b617.text:
Duo
「I'm $$デュオ・マックスウェル$$.
　That's $$ヒイロ・ユイ$$.」

stage0013_03:r_89766f5ffaa912d4.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I've seen both your service records myself.
　Especially you, $$デュオ$$, I hear you were on
　a team called the Short Straw Alliance...」

stage0013_03:r_7c0d3c51f9a11ca0.text:
$$デュオ$$
「Ah, yeah...
　But I'm fine... it's nothing much.」

stage0013_03:r_ab97c2b2418ea732.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I see...
　But please don't push yourself too hard.」

stage0013_03:r_2ddff5064af78db4.text:
$$デュオ$$
「Thanks.
　You're pretty thoughtful, for a robot.」

stage0013_03:r_050d0532c4b24bfe.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Yes, that's about my only redeeming trait.
　Now then, let's get to it... business, business!」
